notes.title: Merry Christmas!
notes.content:
[u][b]Hey, dear supporters! Long time no see![/b][/u]

First of all [b][u][b]Merry Chistmas[/b][/u][/b] to all of you who still follow the development of our dear game.In honor of celebrating our game's first Christmas, the enchanted forest is now dressed in beautiful white color!
Our main protagonists are also in celebrating mood, that's why their coat turned white [b]during [/b]the winter season. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34736569/d9c3805233b3e5180e548530793276896335f6c0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34736569/4d4291e36fa1defd23d0f5405c05aece1062ea0b.gif[/img]
🎅[i]Collect gifts around the map![/i]🎅

Our [u][b][b]kickstarter[/b][/b][/u] has come to a close with a success!We already sent out the codes who supported us there, so this is their first update.
Hi!
Thank you again, for helping us expand faster, and more efficiently so Brood can reach it's full potential!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34736569/64ee964073c8f90a7daa67326f671422b6cd796b.png[/img]

[u][b][b]What's next?[/b][/b][/u]
We are not quite happy with our main protagonist, the fox at the moment.He is not distinct enough from other foxes, so he wont stick out from the various fox games Steam has to offer.We want our fox to pop out from the crowd, so as of [b][b]2020[/b][/b], we will make a huge design change on both characters.
Here's a little [b][b]preview[/b][/b] of that:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34736569/f89aa448fef828564ddd6edb91a5be7702b6190a.png[/img]
[i]Share your thoughts down below![/i]

[i][b]That's it for today, stay tuned for more in 2020![/b][/i]

notes.title: Achievements and Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[u][b]Hi there![/b][/u]
Today, aside from smaller bugfixes is probably the las update as of this Summer. ːsteamsadː
However, this patch brought to you something, lots of you has been asking us to implement since the beginning.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34736569/fbe7312643f68af112b753352d48fc9a72c94123.png[/img]
From now on these[u][b] 7 achievements[/b][/u] will pop up in your profile in honor of supporting our game!These achievements include 5 letters of the [u][b]new logo[/b][/u] to puzzle out the name of the game, and also 2 pictures of the main characters to bring your Steam Profile to the [u][b]next level[/b][/u]!

We also started a [b]Kickstarter[/b] to boost our finances, and make the development much faster and efficient. You can learn more by clicking on the [u][i]below link[/i][/u]:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lightfoxgames/brood


[b]Roy Buff:[/b]
Another fix on the game was the vulnerability of Roy.He died even from the smallest hit he got, and it fustrated people who wanted to take a screenshot of him, and died cause the fox got too close to him.From today on he will take a [b]lot more damage[/b], but can still be killed if people don't want them on their journey.

[b]Terrain textures:[/b]
Last time we checked in we announced the news about Terrain Textures.Now they got even more [b]enchanced[/b]!Go and check them out!

And that's it for today's update.Hope everyone had a wonderful summer!ːsteamhappyː [b]See you soon![/b]

notes.title: Introducing Roy
notes.content:
[b]Hi![/b]
In today's update we are here to indtroduce you to [b]Roy[/b]!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34736569/78f375e505ef8d0f30a0b86bcb22bb3a4106cc56.jpg[/img]

From now on this bird will guide you through your journey. He [u]doesn't fly[/u], not like he can't, but[b] Roy[/b] can keep up with you better on foot.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34736569/75df3c7cabf0093d998c00279b92628e0cfd9acf.gif[/img]

He is[i] faithful[/i] till the end however if you happen to not want him in your way you can...
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34736569/d024fae7987a5dae20b9c7987b17f58b45bca708.gif[/img]
[i]But why would you do that? [/i]

I suppose it's better to keep him by your side he can manage to be more [i]useful [/i]than he seems.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34736569/a223edc69b0186b5e1a76550cb17e47d61f003a7.gif[/img]

[b]Bugfixes on this patch:[/b]
No more skulls that can't be collected on Stage 1
Fishes no longer float on Stage 1

Right now[b] Roy[/b] is [u]only available[/u] on the first stage of the game, but stay tuned you will hear from him[b] soon[/b]!

notes.title: Latest Patch - Collectables!
notes.content:
[u]Hello there![/u]

[b]In today's update[/b] we finally managed to add collactables!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34736569/6be249256bf5353beacb5cbc6639149aec8309e1.gif[/img]

These [b]skulls[/b] in the forest are your items to collect.If you collect all of them you can continue to the next level, this way we are starting to implement a few basic mechanics to the game wehich we intended in the first place!
As of now you won't be able to find a counter for the objects, as we wanted to feature them on the pause menu to not ruin the player experince for those, who make those beautiful screenshots from out little fox! However we will implement it as soon as possible.
We did not want players who don't ususally read Patch Notes to not inerstand why they can't move to the next area so as for now you can switch between the areas as you wish from the start.
[b]But [/b]you can already start collecting! There are 5 skulls each stage you can encounter. On both map different kind of bones can be found:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34736569/4a416f23e08eaf6a446d7240ec898bf1dbf5837c.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34736569/ecf13ff6f3e7ec6a8fd0157787a8400785a400e8.jpg[/img]

The feature is not available in the Test Area however a new little companion will follow you through your visit there. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34736569/8b714c9fbc747ce41938b0b02b8e099fc644e631.gif[/img]

[b]Happy Treasure Hunting![/b]

notes.title: Latest Patch
notes.content:
Hi!
It has been a while since we last reported in the game's status.
Fortunately we are happy to announce that we improved our variety of maps with one addition, now with the temporary name: [i][u]'Test Map'[/u][/i]
Our goal is to create a connected universe each with it's own theme and atmosphere, so don't be tricked with the distinguishing, this map will also be featured in the final build. 
But before all this, it also has another function: testing out our new mechanics (collectibles, new AI system, more detailed environment). For this particular reason, we designed a whole different start button, accessible in the Main Menu. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34736569/641e0654bc6467a898957088609f3d65fc76c09a.png[/img]
We would like to make small updates to it every 2-3 days, but don't be surprised if something goes wrong, while playing it.

If you have any issues playing the new mode, please report it under the [u]"Report a Bug"[/u] topic. 
Thank you for following the development of our game!

notes.title: Wildlife
notes.content:
On this week's patch our project has reached a huge milestone as of now our mystical meadow has been expanded by [u]creatures of all kind[/u].
From bunnies to stags: all kinds of animals are featured a forest could offer.
They have their own mind, which means they'll eat, drink, travel, and attack at their own will.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34736569/820c0795ee9c659260cf909faa4664bedf5763de.jpg[/img]
